title: A memoryless physical device can still require exponential retained response information
statement: For an arbitrary K=2^m-bit Pauli-response table, a controller retaining at most B classical bits and no other f-sensitive access needs B>=K[1-h2(epsilon)] to correct uniformly with mean error epsilon<1/2. A positive acceptance yield must be specified for an erasure version.

requires: A fixed arbitrary K-bit response table, a fresh uniform context, at most B retained classical bits, and no additional f-sensitive oracle, query or uncharged circuit.
provides: For an arbitrary K=2^m-bit Pauli-response table, a controller retaining at most B classical bits and no other f-sensitive access needs B>=K[1-h2(epsilon)] to correct uniformly with mean error epsilon<1/2. A positive acceptance yield must be specified for an erasure version.
assumptions: The correction/error requirement is uniform over every table; the ideal context is granted. An erasure claim requires an explicit positive accepted yield.
costs: K=2^m retained-response complexity is exponential; fresh uniform-context queries replace retention only at explicit acquisition cost.
contract.units: B is classical bits, h2 uses base-two logarithms, and error/yield are dimensionless.
contract.obstruction: No general fault-tolerance threshold, arbitrary future-model compression or infinite-stream guarantee is established. Response complexity can require 2^m[1-h2(error)] retained bits even for a memoryless device; reacquisition is a different paid interface. Completed supplied internal operation audits are retained at their actual model/code scope; this intake does not replay native experiments.

body: Choose the response table as K independent uniform bits. Successful correction on a uniformly random revealed context predicts that table bit. Conditional subadditivity and binary decoding entropy imply H(F|message)<=K*h2(epsilon), so the retained message needs at least K*(1-h2(epsilon)) bits. Rejection without a yield requirement makes the task vacuous. This is response-law information, not continuing quantum-state memory; fresh uniform-context reacquisition is a distinct paid interface.
